brief:
Israeli forces seized 182 dunams of land in the villages of Beit Ur, Shuqba, and al-Shayyukh, Shehab Wire reported. The takeover adds to a pattern of land confiscation in the occupied West Bank.

The three villages fall under varying degrees of Israeli administrative and military control. Palestinian residents have faced repeated land seizures as Israeli settlement construction accelerates across the territory.
